parameters.formDescription: Normalises the Company column on an existing ClayRoots table. Re-runnable and idempotent: a table that is already clean gets zero writes.

values.formSubmittedText: Run started. The Hub run-log row carries the result.

parameters.content:
## Guards, fail closed

Every refusal throws and the message ends with "Nothing was written."

- Base id or table id malformed
- Table id does not resolve in the base
- No literal Company column, or Company is computed

Columns whose name starts with _cc_ are ignored everywhere. Name is never used as a company column: on contacts tables it is the person.

## The page loop

100 records per page, write batches of 10 at 4 requests per second. Only counters survive a page: the row set is dropped before the next fetch. Counters live in workflow static data keyed by execution id and are deleted when the log row is written.

Writes are plain PATCH updates by record id. Never an upsert. Build Date is a CREATED_TIME() formula and is never in a payload.

## What gets written

Source value: Company, falling back to company_clean when Company is blank. The cleaned value is written to BOTH columns when company_clean is a writable text field, and to Company alone when it is aiText, a formula, or otherwise computed.

Quarantine: a result under 3 characters, or a single generic word (home, shop, welcome, about, products, store, index, page, contact), is discarded and the row is left untouched.
